text_blocks.snippet: Yes, blood in the urine (hematuria) can be a symptom of a urinary tract infection (UTI). UTIs can cause inflammation and irritation of the urinary tract, including the bladder, which may lead to blood in the urine. If you experience blood in your urine, it's important to see a doctor to determine the cause and receive appropriate treatment.
